input_audit.rule: Complete half-open 900-second bins;20..100 jobs;1..8 SKUs;both kinds>=5;source ledger0..900;capacity checked;dates sampled first;older sealed dates excluded
input_audit.inference: Dates are independent resampling units; wider workload distribution is reported separately from the original-filter subset; previously researched dates are identified, not treated as fresh holdout.

adoption_rule.selection: minimum equal-date mean raw F on development; CPU then method ties
adoption_rule.default_adoption: selected candidate only; all valid; date F gain bootstrap lower>0; CPU mean<=1.10*gate; no window F regression
adoption_rule.measured_latency: supplementary only; fixed scale=1 step per CPU second; never used for adoption
